description: Ask the user for a file or a secret (API key, token, password) WITHOUT them pasting it into the chat. They answer on a seal.net page: on their computer it opens in their browser by itself, elsewhere they get its link or a card in their inbox; you can pass `where_url` (the page where that key is created) so they find it in one click. With `wait:true` you get the path of the saved 0600 file, never the value. Use this instead of "paste your key here" or "upload the file here".

bind.description: kind=secret: where the key will be used, proposed to the person (seal_address.json guard.bind). The page shows it when no entry of secrets.json knows the key's form; the person confirms, narrows or removes it. The guard then lets the key out only to these hosts.

dir.description: An answer through a link or a card: directory to save it into, created if missing; default a private 0700 directory in the system's temp folder. An existing file is never overwritten: the new one becomes `name (1).ext`. The page opened on this computer saves where the `seal` CLI does.

from.description: `owner`: a card in the connected owner's inbox (`owner_not_paired` without one); `anyone`: a link any person can answer. Without it: the page opens in this computer's browser when there is one, else a card for the owner when connected, else the link.

kind.description: `secret`: a password field; `file`: a file; `any`: a secret, or a file when the field is left empty.

request.description: Handle of a request answered through a link: wait for it.

wait.description: Wait for the answer and return the saved path. Where the answer goes through a link and your client cannot show links itself, the link comes back first: show it and the three words to the user, then call again with `request`.

what.description: What you ask for, as the user reads it: 'Brave API key', 'the call recordings folder'. Required unless `request` is given.

where_url.description: https page where this key is created. The user sees its domain; known services are named, any other domain is marked as given by you.

name: seal_request
title: Ask the user for a file or a secret
